newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Euroairport cargo traffic up 14 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Euroairport cargo traffic up 14 percent in 1996.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Basle-Mulhouse-Freiburg airport (EuroAirport), situated on the French-Swiss border, in 1996, totalled 88,684 tonnes, an increase of 14 percent on 1995, airport authority figures show.
Flown airfreight traffic totalled 49,361 tonnes, an increase of 27 percent on 1995 levels.

"On last year's results, EuroAirport was France's leading provincial airport for airport surpassing, for the first time Marseille, both in terms of tonnage and annual growth," the airport authority said.
The performance was largely due to the launch of several scheduled full-freighter services which showed an increase of 42 percent on 1995 reaching 32,341 tonnes, the airport authority added.
Express airfreight by eight percent on 1995 levels to 13,040 tonnes.
Trucked airfreight traffic was up two percent on the previous year's levels at 39,323 tonnes.
Postal traffic totalled 3,289 tonnes, up nine percent on 1995. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
